name: Script template
description: A neutral example that shows every input type and every option you can declare. Copy this folder, rename it, and edit config.json + the .py file.
author: Your name here

parameters.name: text_input
parameters.label: Text input (single line)
parameters.description: type "string" -> a single-line text box (QLineEdit). Optional keys: 'default', 'required'.

parameters.name: long_text_input
parameters.label: Text input (multi-line)
parameters.description: type "text" -> a resizable multi-line box (QTextEdit), for longer notes. Optional keys: 'default', 'required'.

parameters.name: whole_number
parameters.label: Whole number input
parameters.description: type "int" -> an integer stepper (QSpinBox). Optional keys: 'min', 'max', 'default', 'required'. Arrives in the script as a Python int.

parameters.name: whole_number_unbounded
parameters.label: Whole number input (no limits)
parameters.description: The same "int" type without 'min'/'max'. Omit those keys to allow any integer.

parameters.name: decimal_number
parameters.label: Decimal number input
parameters.description: type "float" -> a decimal stepper (QDoubleSpinBox). Optional keys: 'min', 'max', 'decimals' (digits shown), 'default'. Arrives as a Python float.

parameters.name: checkbox_option
parameters.label: Checkbox input
parameters.description: type "bool" -> a checkbox (QCheckBox). Optional key: 'default' (true/false). Arrives as Python True or False.

parameters.name: dropdown_option
parameters.label: Dropdown input
parameters.description: type "choice" -> a drop-down list (QComboBox). Requires 'options'. Optional key: 'default' (must be one of the options). Arrives as one of the option strings.

parameters.name: file_input
parameters.label: File input
parameters.description: type "file" -> a text box with a Browse button (file picker). Optional keys: 'extensions' (filters the dialog), 'required', 'default'. Arrives as an absolute path string. Marked required, so it shows a * and must be set before running.

parameters.name: file_input_any_type
parameters.label: File input (any type)
parameters.description: The same "file" type without 'extensions', so the picker shows all files. No 'required' key, so it is optional.

parameters.name: folder_input
parameters.label: Folder input
parameters.description: type "directory" -> a text box with a Browse button (folder picker). Optional keys: 'required', 'default'. Arrives as an absolute path string; create it with os.makedirs if needed.

description.en: Any 'label' or 'description' can be a locale map {"en": ..., "es": ...} instead of a plain string, so your script's UI follows the app language.
description.es: Cualquier 'label' o 'description' puede ser un mapa de idiomas para que la interfaz siga el idioma de la aplicacion.

parameters.name: linked_file_input
parameters.label: Linked file input
parameters.description: Add 'link': "<script_id>.<output_key>" to auto-fill this field from an earlier script's output. It is only a default: the user can re-point or clear the link with the link button. The reference must match a key in that script's 'outputs'.

outputs.output_file: Absolute path to the main file this script produced.
outputs.output_folder: Absolute path to a folder holding any additional results (figures, tables, ...).
